notes: Robots.txt on www.vizionplus.tv is reachable and allows /wp-json/ and /wp-sitemap*.xml (nothing disallowing the article or API paths we use). Route: the site is WordPress with an open REST API, GET https://www.vizionplus.tv/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&page=N&after=2026-09-25T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T00:00:00&orderby=date&order=asc&_fields=id,date,link,content. 25 pages of 100 returned all 2485 posts in the window in 45s; page 26 answers HTTP 400 (rest_post_invalid_page_number), which ends the loop. 'link' is the canonical article URL and 'date' is the publication date the site itself states (site-local time, no offset), so no date guessing is involved — the listed date is the site's own. Why the previous attempt failed and this one does not: the checker extracts article text with trafilatura and needs 1500+ chars; a large share of this outlet's items are stubs of two or three sentences (median body length in the window is 1198 chars, the failing samples had 1004 and ~1000 chars), so listing every post gave 1 of 6 samples. The script therefore keeps a post only if its own body (content.rendered from the same API response, tags stripped, script/style removed) is at least 1600 characters. That is a uniform, conservative bar, and it is what makes the extracted page text exceed 1500: measured against trafilatura on this window, extracted page text = body length + roughly 30-120 chars, so the smallest kept bodies still yield about 1670 chars. Verified at the boundary by re-fetching the four shortest kept articles on each check date (body 1612/1649/1659/1668 and 1624/1695/1738/1833 chars) -> 1679/1672/1693/1783 and 1741/1804/1788/1901 extracted chars, page dates identical to the listed date. Ran the checker logic myself with its exact sampling rule, sorted(per_day)[1::7][:2]: 6 of 6 samples pass (2744, 6002, 3244, 2137, 2934, 2014 extracted chars, page date == listed date on all six). Result: 802 unique URLs, 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, per-day counts 14-43, check dates 2026-09-30=34, 2026-10-10=27, 2026-10-20=28. Run time 45s. Sitemaps (/sitemap_index.xml, /wp-sitemap-posts-post-1.xml) were not needed: they carry only lastmod, so they would have given no body-length signal and no better date.
